title: Zyxel Vulnerability CVE-2023-28771: A Threat to Your Network
description: A retrospective defensive analysis of CVE-2023-28771, covering firewall log interpretation, affected Zyxel product families, investigation guidance, and mitigation.

title: A Universal Malware Analysis Framework: Pattern, Behaviour, Observation & Detection
description: A repeatable, evidence-driven methodology for analysing suspicious files across Windows, Android, Linux, and macOS, from triage through behavioural validation and detection.

title: Agentic AI for Threat Hunting: From Threat Intelligence to Evidence-Driven Investigation
description: A public-safe overview of AI-assisted threat hunting, covering intelligence analysis, hunt preparation, SIEM investigation, evidence collection, and structured reporting.

title: When Signatures Break: Polymorphic Malware and Behaviour-Based Detection
description: A practical research article on polymorphic and metamorphic code, layered malware detection, a synthetic YARA exercise, Sigma behavioural detection, and validation methodology.

title: Beyond Strings: PE Structure, Entropy and YARA Engineering
description: Explore PE metadata, imports, structural indicators, feature stability, rule specificity, and false-positive control for file-based detections.

title: From Process Tree to Attack Story: Turning Sandbox Evidence into Hypotheses
description: Correlate process, file, registry, and network observations into a defensible investigation timeline and ATT&CK mapping.

title: Sigma Rules That Survive Tool Changes: From Event Logic to SIEM Analytics
description: Design portable behavioural detections, document required telemetry, validate field mappings, and tune environmental noise.

title: Reconstructing a Malware Campaign: From Public Reporting to Detection Coverage
description: A research workflow for building a sourced attack timeline, separating observations from inference, mapping ATT&CK techniques, and identifying detection opportunities.
editorial_note: Verify the selected campaign and all claims against primary or high-quality sources before publication.

title: Detection Is a Hypothesis Until Tested: Measuring Precision, Recall and Blind Spots
description: Build a repeatable detection evaluation process with positive and benign test cases, false-positive review, coverage limitations, and reproducible results.

title: Building AssemblyLab: An Interactive Assembly Learning Lab for Reverse Engineering
description: Explore AssemblyLab, a browser-based learning platform featuring assembly fundamentals, CPU registers, memory addressing, control flow, x86-64 vs ARM64, and interactive reverse-engineering challenges. Includes lessons learned from deploying the project with GitHub Pages and configuring a custom domain.
